reading.body:
iGLASS Networks operates a facility in Cary, North Carolina for which it publishes no power capacity, square footage, or IT load specifications. The company's own website does not disclose these figures. Without published capacity data, the site's scale relative to AI infrastructure deployment cannot be assessed from available sources.

North Carolina has 19 mapped data center facilities of which 5 publish power capacity figures totaling 50.3 MW. iGLASS Networks Cary ranks sixth among published facilities in the state, which indicates it either publishes a figure smaller than the fifth-ranked site or is included in a ranking based on other criteria not specified in the data provided.

Whether this campus matters to AI scaling cannot be determined from published specifications. The operator has chosen not to disclose the power, space, or density figures required to compare it to other infrastructure. Prospective users or investors would need to contact the company directly.
